DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (secondary to Atrial Septal Defect)

The normal liver enzymes and bilirubin make acute hepatitis unlikely, but your history of an atrial septal defect combined with these signs of fluid overload—rapid breathing, liver enlargement, and pitting edema—strongly suggests your heart is failing to pump effectively, causing fluid to back up into your body. Do you have any history of heart murmurs, or do you notice fatigue when playing or running?
